sentences.en: As soon as it gets dark, the fireworks will start.
sentences.zh: 天一黑，烟火就开始燃放。

sentences.en: These animals were startled by the noise of the fireworks.
sentences.zh: 这些动物被烟火的声音吓了一跳。

sentences.en: We enjoyed watching the fireworks on a bridge last summer.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天我们在一座桥上欣赏烟火时非常开心。

senses.zh: 烟花；烟花表演；烟花大会(常用复数形式fireworks)
